title: Should Homework Be Banned?
text:
Many students spend hours on homework every night. Some people think homework helps students remember what they learn in class. In my opinion, a little homework is useful because it helps students practise at home.

However, too much homework can make students tired and stressed. Students also need time to play sports and spend time with their families. For this reason, I believe teachers should give short homework tasks that are not too difficult.

questions.text: According to paragraph one, why do some people think homework helps students?
options: It helps students remember what they learn in class

questions.text: According to paragraph two, what can too much homework make students feel?
What can the reader infer about the writer's view of a little homework?
options: The writer thinks it is useful
The writer thinks it is harmful
The writer thinks it is unnecessary
The writer thinks it is only for teachers

questions.text: What does the writer probably want teachers to do?
options: Stop giving any homework at all

paragraph_translations: Muchos estudiantes pasan horas haciendo los deberes cada noche. Algunas personas piensan que los deberes ayudan a los estudiantes a recordar lo que aprenden en clase. En mi opinión, un poco de tarea es útil porque ayuda a los estudiantes a practicar en casa.

Sin embargo, demasiados deberes pueden cansar y estresar a los estudiantes. Los estudiantes también necesitan tiempo para hacer deporte y pasar tiempo con sus familias. Por eso, creo que los profesores deberían dar tareas cortas que no sean muy difíciles.
